description: record_callable_shape_surface_publications ignores its surface_shapes param (let _ = surface_shapes). The 4 callers compute it via callable_surface_shapes_for_demand -> surface_shape -> generic_shape_from_demand, which RECORDS callables into delta as a side effect. So removing the param cleanly requires proving that side-effect recording is unneeded (or independently triggered) -- needs oracle validation, not a quick edit. Deferred; do not remove the param without confirming the recorded callables are not consumed by the plan.
title: Investigate dead surface_shapes param in record_callable_shape_surface_publications
